description: The bar chart illustrates the average, 50%, 75%, and 90% retrieval times for different components of a web-enhanced question answering system: Search, Extract, Fetch, and Retrieval. The horizontal axis represents the retrieval time percentage, while the vertical axis indicates the time in seconds. The chart shows that the Retrieval component has the highest average time, followed by Fetch, Search, and Extract. At the 50% retrieval time, the Fetch component has the longest time, with Search and Extract being shorter. At the 75% and 90% retrieval times, the Fetch component continues to have the longest time, with the other components showing shorter times. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
